lanes.closure: Every position, transform, camera, and physics vector instruction reachable in the executed Mission 01 cone has retail bytes, positive control and handwritten native semantics; micro-execution is required only for a documented ambiguity that static and bit-exact controls cannot resolve.
blockers: The raw 0x40-byte locator copy at 0x822A6710 is now statically qualified and corpus-reachable for all fifteen missions without micro-execution; the remaining Mission 01 reachable instruction census is not sealed.
Huge finite angles, floating-point exception details, NaN payloads, interpolation, and unsupported Xenon instruction families remain explicit open boundaries.

blockers: The direct mode-2 target path, mode-3 cubic gain, non-mode-3 scalar tail, small-direction threshold path, 0x8225C680 radial normalizer, caller-side identity guard, and active/hit/miss core of 0x82281198 are bounded; the upstream matrix/VMX128 direction producer, VMX estimate path, retail trigonometric factor producer, mode-1 heading correction/override, two tunnel geometry callbacks, vertical fallback, manager publication join, and remaining 0x82262A28 joins are still open.

blockers: moviepack.bin has no static join to the Mission 01 briefing, gameplay, or debrief and is no longer a preview blocker; its complete 6,528-range reader remains a shared-cache regression guard only.
